snippet.title: Football Power Arcade
snippet.description:
Football Power is a video game where the player uses a joystick and an actually soccer ball to control the action.
The soccer ball is connected to a full 3-axis football interface, and when the player kicks the ball, the game reads the strength and direction of the shot.
